notes: J-GAAP throughout; fiscal years end20March, not31March. Financial statement yen millions scaled to full yen; capex is the explicitly published negative Capital expenditures cash-flow line.
Total equity is reported directly without noncontrolling interest in the inspected balance sheets. Net income uses the highlighted net income, identical to owners in the audited statements.

Reports disclose basic EPS; no invented diluted figure. Treasury and issued share counts are not subtracted. No aggregate total debt is published in these extracts; not inferred from the lack of a borrowing line.

Each paired prior year uses the comparative in the next annual report. No restatement claim is made unless explicitly identified. Dividends are on each report's published share basis; stock splits mean per-share amounts across reports require care.
